title: Sparse exact fourteen-way ContextMap3 associativity

objective.role: probability-identical semantic memory compaction for the authoritative CMIX parent

prior_pooled_overflow_theorem.relationship: The theorem warns that a fixed private-plus-global-pool layout strands capacity. This design avoids that false inference by allocating one complete four-slot overflow record per owning bucket on first demand, with no fixed global capacity ceiling.

fixed_bucket_packing_theorem.relationship: The 96-byte ten-way base geometry is reused, but the logical predictor remains fourteen-way through sparse overflow.

overflow_allocation.arena_rule: Each ContextMap3 reserves one contiguous MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS|MAP_NORESERVE virtual arena large enough for one 36-byte overflow record per semantic bucket. A deterministic per-instance bump index packs only activated records into the arena prefix.
overflow_allocation.handle_rule: overflow_index_plus_one == 0 means no record; otherwise subtract one and index the owning instance's contiguous overflow arena
overflow_allocation.reset_rule: After all cp and runp pointers are redirected to base state, MADV_DONTNEED the previously touched overflow prefix and reset the deterministic bump index to zero.
overflow_allocation.pointer_stability: An arena never moves while coding; cp and runp may point into either the base record or its owning instance's overflow arena.
overflow_allocation.resource_boundary: Virtual reservation is recorded separately and is not claimed as resident-memory saving. RSS, cgroup memory including page tables, faults, I/O, and any virtual-address limit require native measurement.

sparse_representation.resident_user_page_upper_bound_equation: 4000309248 + sum_i(ceil(36*O_i/4096) * 4096), excluding measured page tables, allocator metadata, and non-ContextMap3 state
sparse_representation.conservative_saving_equation: 1333436416 - 36*O - 167895, where O=sum_i O_i; native RSS and cgroup gates remain authoritative

logical_equivalence_contract: Slots retain the parent indexes 0 through 13; indexes 0 through 9 reside in the base and indexes 10 through 13 reside in the optional owned overflow record.
An absent overflow record represents four exactly zero parent slots.
The overflow record is allocated and zeroed exactly when the parent transition first selects a slot from 10 through 13.

The recent0 fast path, complete lowest-index checksum match, recent0/recent1 protection, strict-lowest-priority victim scan, keep bits, state update, run model, and tie order are identical to the parent over the logical fourteen slots.
Allocation handles, virtual addresses, arena page boundaries, filenames, page residency, and fault order are excluded from predictor state.

Encoder and decoder observe the same prior bytes and therefore allocate the same logical overflow record before the same write. Induction then requires identical logical table state, integer probabilities, coder intervals, payload, and inverse.

matched_arms.K: P with count-only overflow-demand observation and no predictor write
matched_arms.C: plain E1<10,96> compact control with no overflow; zero parent-identity authority

activation.blocked_while: cmix_filebacked_fxcm_full_a_qm8_v1 or any descendant owns the full-1G lane or managed lease
authorize_only_if: qm8 terminalizes with exact semantics but misses the 9,000,000 KiB engineering target
or the later exact-package runtime gate attributes failure to q1 reclaim/writeback pressure
activation.suppression_rule: If q1 passes exact A/B memory and exact-package runtime with sufficient adaptation headroom, retain q1 and do not build this correction merely because its static bound is attractive.

future_gate_ladder: source-level exhaustive get/update equivalence over empty, hit, checksum-collision, every victim index, both protected indexes, overflow allocation, reset/decommit, and arena-page-boundary cases
250KB P/K/D exact post-head integer-probability, coder-checkpoint, payload, inverse, and repeat identity
opening and distant cold-reset 10M P/K/D identity plus overflow counts, process-tree RSS, VmHWM, cgroup, I/O, scratch, and runtime
full-1G exact payload, archive, inverse, cleanup, memory, runtime, package, dependency, and independent-repeat proof
kill_conditions: Any logical state, probability, coder checkpoint, payload, inverse, or repeat mismatch retires D as an implementation failure; it cannot be relabeled a compression candidate.
A monotonic overflow count above the conservative bound before full scope proves the 262,144 KiB static reduction gate unreachable and retires this representation.
A full resource gate reducing peak tree RSS by less than 262,144 KiB or failing to reach at most 8,750,000 KiB retires this realization.
A runtime, virtual-address, or package failure retires the exact sparse representation without changing base ways, overflow ways, record size, arena policy, or replacement semantics in a rescue.
